# Anne Shirley & Lynde

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) — gave Anne a hearty embrace and bade her farewell before she left for college · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana.md) over for tea while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) attends a meeting in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). During the visit, [Anne](../character/anne.md) inadvertently serves [Diana](../character/diana.md) three glassfuls of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana.md) to feel dizzy and sick and go home early. On Monday, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she deliberately got [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together, whereupon [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the wine bottle and realizes her mistake in storing it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) attend a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy the event together. Upon returning home, they leap into the spare-room bed as a game, unwittingly jumping directly onto Diana's visiting great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). The resulting uproar leaves [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) furious and threatens Diana's music lessons, prompting a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne.md) to seek a way to make amends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her mistake with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before going to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to take the blame directly. She bravely confronts the angry Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) and explains her perspective, winning over the old lady with her sincerity and imagination. [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all, and she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) become firm friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns from school emotional about Mr. Phillips's departure and shares news of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. After praising Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and making extensive preparations with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) bakes a layer cake for the minister and his wife's visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During tea, Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sample the cake, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to react in shock at its unusual taste.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> During a party at Diana's house, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in [Anne](../character/anne.md) falling and breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) experiences a deep realization of how much she cares for the girl. Bedridden for seven weeks while her ankle heals, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne.md) eagerly embraces despite Marilla's skepticism. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) criticizes the concert as a distraction from schoolwork, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) warmly encourages Anne's enthusiasm.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on her silent academic rivalry and unspoken regret concerning [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exam. [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly packs away her books for a fun summer at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visits [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and commends Anne's growth and character.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> While driving back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) spot a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's wet oat field and chase it into the lane. Believing the cow to be her own mischievous animal, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), an annoyed [Anne](../character/anne.md) impetuously sells it on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers her real cow still in the milking pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow. Horrified by her mistake, [Anne](../character/anne.md) packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess to Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md).
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

> On the evening before school opens, [Anne](../character/anne.md), Jane, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate their teaching methods and views on corporal punishment at a crossroads. [Anne](../character/anne.md) then walks back through her favorite spots, avoids Mrs. Lynde's unsolicited advice at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule without whipping. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne.md) is comforted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as she prepares for her first day as a teacher.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne.md) will expose his corruption and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to cancel the ad deal to keep her quiet, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to make a deal and simply keeps the secret out of principle.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to do household chores while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes to help Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). While transferring bed feathers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly applies rug dye to her nose instead of freckle lotion, turning it bright red just before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) wash off the dye and supplies a roast chicken, allowing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to successfully entertain her visitors with a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) bids a tearful farewell to her home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and leaves for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). After a rainy drive to the station and a boat ride from [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) travel by train to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne.md) is warmly met by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her by cab to their new boardinghouse while cheering her up.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), finding themselves drawn into social circles through their friendship with [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) earns distinction among the Freshmen after leading them to victory in the annual Arts Rush. Anne's homesickness is relieved when she receives a collection of letters from her friends and family back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home
